name: hud_sensor_map_shutdown_and_reset
description: HudSensorTracker::MapShutdownAndReset ends the map overlay, removes all map nodes, frees the loaded map path, reinitializes map state, and returns success.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4167a0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same shutdown/reset sequence.
The dependency frontier for 0x4167a0 has no visible source blockers after accepting MapRemoveNode and Init.
